brief.headline: Semis split: AMD +5.9% on 2.2x volume, NVDA -4.3% on 4.9x volume; small caps -1.6%.
tldr: AMD and AVGO surged on heavy volume, NVDA and SMCI dumped.
Small caps (IWM) fell 1.6%, equal-weight S&P 500 dropped 0.9%.
10Y yield rose 10.5 bps to 5.10%, TLT lost 1.5%.

where_money_moved.evidence: AMD drew $19.3B inflow, +5.9% on 2.2x volume; AVGO $10.1B inflow, +5.5% on 1.9x volume.
NVDA lost $4.3B outflow, -4.3% on 4.9x volume; SMCI $1.9B outflow, -11.3% on 2.4x volume.
IWM saw $4.9B outflow, -1.6% on 1.0x volume; RSP $1.0B outflow, -0.9% on 0.8x volume.

who_is_driving.name: NVDA
who_is_driving.why: Drove 48.5% of the session's dollar-weighted move lower; -4.3% on 4.9x volume, bottom 4% of its past year.

who_is_driving.name: AMD
who_is_driving.why: Drove 17.1% of the session's dollar-weighted move higher; +5.9% on 2.2x volume, 89th percentile of its past year.

who_is_driving.name: AVGO
who_is_driving.why: Drove 8.0% of the session's dollar-weighted move higher; +5.5% on 1.9x volume, 98th percentile of its past year.

key_tech.signal: Money rotated from NVDA/SMCI into AMD/AVGO; net inflow $22.8B, but breadth only 25% up.
CEG rose 2.8% on 1.2x volume, but SMR fell 7.8%; net inflow $322M, breadth 29% up.
Outflow $2.6B; MSTR -6.5% on 1.1x volume, HOOD -3.8%; Bitcoin -2.8% on 1.9x volume.
Outflow $708M; IONQ -9.4%, QTUM -1.2%; breadth 0% up, speculative names hit hard.

stocks.note: Fell 11.3% on 2.4x volume, bottom 1% of its past year; $1.9B outflow.
Rose 5.9% on 2.2x volume, 89th percentile; $19.3B inflow, largest single-name inflow.
Fell 4.3% on 4.9x volume, bottom 4% of its past year; $4.3B outflow, 48.5% of session's dollar-weighted move.

risks: 10Y yield at 5.10% (+10.5 bps) pressures rate-sensitive assets; TLT -1.5% on 1.3x volume.
Breadth weak: only 18% of names rose, 73% fell; equal-weight S&P 500 -0.9% vs cap-weighted -0.4%.
watch_tomorrow: Whether NVDA outflow continues or stabilizes; its 4.9x volume suggests conviction selling.
AMD/AVGO follow-through: both at high percentiles (89th and 98th) after large inflows.
